scope: Restore keyboard focus to the control that opened a mobile drawer when the user closes it by clicking the canvas scrim, including the case where the pointer click leaves document.activeElement outside the panel.

implementation.root_cause: When a mobile drawer was closed from its scrim, the pointer click could move focus outside the panel before setPanel checked whether focus was still inside it. The existing conditional focus restoration then did not return keyboard focus to the drawer opener.
implementation.fix: The scrim close handler captures the active mobile drawer side, closes both drawers without competing focus restoration, then focuses the recorded connected opener; if that opener is unavailable, it falls back to the matching left/right drawer control. It clears the remembered target after close.
implementation.reuse_and_license: Extended the existing first-party mobile drawer focus lifecycle and Chromium test fixture. No external code or runtime dependency was added.
